push notification.note: Established in mobile and webapp vi.json.

share extension.note: No existing vi rendering; follows Apple's Vietnamese localization of iOS share extensions.

bottom sheet.note: No existing vi rendering; describes the panel sliding up from the bottom. Rarely user-facing.

swipe.note: Established in mobile vi.json ('Vuốt sang trái').

tap.note: 'Chạm' (Apple convention) is also common; mobile vi.json favors 'nhấn' for actionable instructions — keep one consistently.

toast.note: No existing vi rendering; a brief transient confirmation message.

clipboard.note: Majority in mobile vi.json (one string uses 'bảng nhớ tạm'); prefer 'khay nhớ tạm'.

passcode.note: Follows Apple's Vietnamese localization; distinct from password = 'mật khẩu'.

jailbroken.note: mobile vi.json uses 'thiết bị bẻ khóa' covering both jailbroken and rooted.

deep link.note: No existing vi rendering; standard Vietnamese tech term.

skin tone.note: mobile vi.json mixes 'màu da' and 'tông màu da'; prefer 'tông màu da' (majority).

server connection.note: Add a server = 'Thêm máy chủ' (established); switch server = 'chuyển máy chủ'.
